thread:
jen: Heads-up — need a quick sync on copy + routing for the three product pages (Hosted, Dedicated, Private). goal = launch posts + webinar signups + clear lead routing.
matt: I sketched two hero directions: 1) capability-led (latency/cost wins) 2) trust-led (SLA/isolated infra). leaning #1 for dev audiences.
sasha: +1 on capability for top of funnel, but we need a short toggleable line for enterprise visitors that shifts to trust-led.
liam: For routing: can we use a single page but route based on ?mode=dedicated or ?aud=enterprise to different forms/UTMs. then map to sales queues.
samira: Webinar plan: Nov 12, 10am PT — Samira (ops) + Matt (benchmarks). CTA on page should be “Join the benchmark deep-dive” and a secondary CTA “Start free hosted trial”.
jen: Good — keep two CTAs in hero: primary = webinar (captures warm leads), secondary = try hosted (self-serve). For Dedicated/Private query params primary should flip to “Request a demo”.
matt: Wire snippet for dev CTA copy proposals: A) "Predictable inference. Low cost. Ship faster." B) "High-throughput LLM serving for production apps." which do people prefer?
sasha: I like A because it's benefit-first and unique. B feels generic.
liam: We'll need UTM rules for inbound posts. Suggested: utm_campaign=nov-bench, utm_source=launchpost, utm_content=hosted|dedicated|private depending on mode. sales ops can then filter.
jen: Routing matrix draft: hosted -> self-serve signup form -> marketing SDR nurture. dedicated (& ?mode=dedicated) -> dedicated demo form -> sales AE queue. private (& ?mode=private or ?aud=enterprise) -> contact enterprise -> enterprise AE. capture checkbox for compliance/regulatory to boost priority.
samira: Good call on compliance. Also add a funnel tag if they click webinar but also have ?aud=enterprise — treat as high intent and route to AE after webinar.
marketing-bot: Benchmarks doc updated: https://docs.redwood.com/benchmarks/nov-bench (added p95 latency graphs + cost per 1k tokens).
matt: For the page microcopy: below hero we should have 3 horizontal cards: Performance | Economics | Deployment modes. each card needs a 12-15 word blurb and then a CTA that respects routing.
sasha: Draft blurbs: Performance: "Latency SLOs for production LLMs with autoscale and batching." Economics: "Lower per-token costs with intelligent batching, caching and quantization guidance." Deployment modes: "Hosted, Dedicated, or Private — same API, same toolchain." feedback?
jen: (typo) jen: tweak Deployment modes to be more active: "One API, any deployment: hosted, reserved capacity, or private VPC."
liam: Implementation note for engineers — route example (pseudocode):
```
if (params.mode === 'private' || params.aud === 'enterprise') routeTo('enterprise_contact');
else if (params.mode === 'dedicated') routeTo('dedicated_demo');
else routeTo('self_serve');
```
Keep utm parsing first then fallback to inferred intent.
samira: Webinar registration form should include a hidden field for utm_campaign and a radio for "I represent" (startup / mid-market / enterprise) to help routing after signups.
matt: Quick survey on hero A vs B — react with :one: for A, :two: for B.
sasha: :one:
liam: :one:
samira: :one: :thumbsup:
jen: :one: agreed.
marketing-bot: Reminder — publish new hero A copy to staging by EOD Tue for review.
jen: Next steps: matt update hero and three card blurbs, liam wire up query param routing and utm mapping, samira build webinar registration form with fields noted, sasha finalize microcopy tone. I'll run a 20-min review Wed 9am PT.
matt: Will push copy to /staging/pages/hosted-dedicated-private and ping here when live.
liam: I'll drop a short PR with routing map and tests.
samira: I'll draft the webinar landing content and two email sequences (pre and post).
sasha: I'll draft the 12-15 word card blurbs and a quick FAQ (deployment, security, pricing) to slot under the cards.
jen: thanks team — let's keep comments short in this thread. if urgent ping me DM. :rocket:
